Haru Urara's journey in the Twinkle Series 
had begun. Her goal: to take 1st place in 
any race at all!

However, Haru Urara, lacking much 
concentration, completely forgot about 
training and ran off to play.

"Will the easily distracted Haru Urara be 
able to keep up her training and safely 
claim '1st place'?"
